articles.title: Tensor Auto weighs pre-IPO fundraising ahead of planned US listing – report
articles.mainIdea: Tensor Auto weighs pre-IPO fundraising ahead of planned US listing – report
articles.summary: Just Auto: Tensor Auto weighs pre-IPO fundraising ahead of planned US listing – report. The California-based company is working with Royal Bank of Canada on the process and has started approaching prospective investors.

articles.title: Hiltzik: Uber's trying to snow voters with a supposedly pro-consumer ballot initiative. Don't buy it
articles.mainIdea: Hiltzik: Uber's trying to snow voters with a supposedly pro-consumer ballot initiative. Don't buy it
articles.summary: LA Times: Hiltzik: Uber's trying to snow voters with a supposedly pro-consumer ballot initiative. Don't buy it. Uber says its proposed ballot initiative will save consumers money. It's really designed to save Uber money, at its passengers' expense.

articles.mainIdea: ‘I’m considering driving Lyft part time’: I’m 58 with a $1 million home. Do I finally give up work and enjoy life?
articles.summary: MarketWatch: ‘I’m considering driving Lyft part time’: I’m 58 with a $1 million home. Do I finally give up work and enjoy life?. “One thought is for me to stop working at age 60, while my wife continues for two more years at her teaching job.”
